open_points.subject: M11 OperationBinding / propose+accept binding actions
open_points.text: "binding_id: minted at random by the kernel when proposed; two proposals with equal content are two bindings;" and "status: proposed or accepted"
open_points.question: Can multiple accepted bindings for the same (service_id, operation_name, record_digest) coexist, including with identical ports, or must acceptance enforce uniqueness/replacement?
options: Allow multiple accepted bindings to coexist; flows choose by binding_id
Allow only one accepted binding per (service_id, operation_name, record_digest); later acceptance is refused
Allow only one accepted binding per operation; a new acceptance supersedes/revokes the previous one
open_points.default_guess: Allow coexistence and keep each accepted binding immutable, selected explicitly by binding_id in flows.

open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval / approve-or-refuse effect action
open_points.text: "the kernel then sends under an active grant when one applies, otherwise requests a new approval"
open_points.question: For one waiting effect point (run_id, node_id, map_index), how many approvals in status `requested` may exist at once, and how is the approvable one selected?
options: At most one `requested` approval per waiting point; new request is refused/reuses existing
Multiple `requested` approvals are allowed; owner decides any, executor uses the latest matching request_digest
Multiple are allowed only across different request_digest values
open_points.default_guess: Keep at most one open `requested` approval per waiting point and create a new one only after the prior one is decided or no longer usable.

open_points.subject: M10 ManifestOperation + M28 Installation / read and invoke service operation actions
open_points.text: "base_url: the manifest's base URL of the one instance the installation selects for the service" and "required_headers, instance_class ... each is absent when the installation selects no instance"
open_points.question: When no instance is selected for a service, does ManifestOperation still exist as a readable model for that service operation, and is `base_url` absent or is reading refused?
options: ManifestOperation reading is refused for unselected services
ManifestOperation is readable but `base_url` (and instance-derived fields) are absent; invocation is refused
ManifestOperation is readable with some fallback base_url
open_points.default_guess: Allow reading manifest operation metadata but treat instance-derived fields (including base_url) as absent and refuse invocation.

open_points.subject: M05 Implementation + inspect/repair reads
open_points.text: "Read by trial, admission and the sandbox; shown to the agent repairing its slot" and K-12 "for composition, contracts, bindings and not implementation bodies"
open_points.question: Which principals may read implementation source bodies via inspect: owner, any agent, only may-author agents, or only in a repair-scoped call?
options: Owner and all agents can read code
Owner only; agents get code only through a dedicated repair path
Only metadata is inspectable; code is never returned
open_points.default_guess: Owner and may-author agents can read implementation code; non-author agents receive metadata only.
